items.title: Pay claimed debt to creditor
items.quote: Halten Sie die Forderung für berechtigt, begleichen Sie die Summe samt laufender Zinsen binnen zwei Wochen seit Zustellung dieses Bescheids direkt bei der Antragstellerin.
items.computation: Formal personal delivery is stated explicitly: uebergeben am 20.11.2026 an den Empfaenger persoenlich. That stated delivery date (Friday, 20 Nov 2026) is the delivery day and counts as such, no delivery-fiction days are added for formal personal service. Period is two weeks from delivery. Under Section 187(1) BGB the delivery day itself is not counted; for a period in weeks it ends on the day bearing the same weekday name two weeks later, i.e. 20 Nov 2026 plus 14 days equals 4 Dec 2026, a Friday. That day is not a Saturday, Sunday or Bavarian public holiday, so Section 193 BGB does not move it.

items.title: File Widerspruch with the Mahngericht
items.quote: Bestreiten Sie sie ganz oder zum Teil, teilen Sie dem Mahngericht innerhalb derselben Frist mit, dass Sie Widerspruch erheben; verwenden Sie dafür möglichst den beigelegten Vordruck.
items.computation: Same two-week period as the payment obligation, running from the stated personal delivery date of 20 Nov 2026 (Friday). The delivery day is not counted (Section 187(1) BGB); the period ends two weeks later on the corresponding weekday (Section 188(2) BGB), i.e. 4 Dec 2026, a Friday. Since this day is not a Saturday, Sunday or Bavarian public holiday, Section 193 BGB does not shift it. The Widerspruch must reach the Mahngericht by that date.

warnings: This Mahnbescheid is issued solely on the creditor's own statements and has not been checked by the court; the recipient should independently verify whether the underlying membership-fee claim is actually owed before paying.

If no payment is made and no Widerspruch is filed within the two-week period, the creditor can obtain a Vollstreckungsbescheid allowing enforcement measures such as an account garnishment, so missing the 4 Dec 2026 deadline has serious consequences.
